page.layout: One printed page, all text centred in one block. Upper part: faded title lines in large capitals, about y 80 to 560. Middle: blank. Lower part: small imprint lines near the foot, about y 1550 to 1620. No margin notes. The brown mark at top left is a stamp, not text.
page.notes: The scan is very faint. Most of the page is show-through from the reverse, and the title lines are too faded to read reliably, so I have marked them as illegible and given only approximate lengths. The imprint at the foot (about y 1550 to 1620) is barely visible; it appears to begin with "Apud" but I cannot confirm this, so I have not transcribed it. Stain and discolouration in the centre and right. A small mark like "IV" or "VI" lies in the left margin near y 1350, which may be a stray mark or show-through, so I have left it out. The brown stamp at top left is a digitiser or library mark and is excluded.
